slides.title: Year-end renewal quiz: can you get 3/3?
slides.body: Answers on each slide. Be honest.

slides.label: Question 1
slides.title: Your insurance renewed. Does the client's copy of your COI update too?
slides.body: Nope. A COI is a snapshot. They keep the old one until you send the new one.

slides.label: Question 2
slides.title: Your business license expires Dec 31. When do you start the renewal?
slides.body: A few weeks ahead. Forms, fees, proof of insurance and holiday office hours all take time.

slides.label: Question 3
slides.title: The renewal notice went to an employee who left in March. Who reads it?
slides.body: Nobody. Send renewal notices to a shared inbox, not one person. Comment your score.
